title: A simulated cosmic web
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Cosmic-web visualizations often use color to represent simulated or inferred matter. The colors communicate the model; they are not necessarily the scene's natural visual appearance.

misconception: A learner may choose: Every colored filament is an ordinary visible-light photograph
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: When a visualization colors filaments in a cosmic-web simulation, what should a viewer remember?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: When a visualization colors filaments in a cosmic-web simulation, what should a viewer remember? The colors illustrate modeled matter and are not necessarily what eyes would see. Cosmic-web visualizations often use color to represent simulated or inferred matter. The colors communicate the model; they are not necessarily the scene's natural visual appearance.
Visual caption: Color can encode a model. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: When a visualization colors filaments in a cosmic-web simulation, what should a viewer remember?
options: The colors illustrate modeled matter and are not necessarily what eyes would see
Every colored filament is an ordinary visible-light photograph
The simulation is a literal picture of the entire universe
